patch.value: Release continuation frees the runner while protected PR checks run
Implement pm-ops#249: durable candidate intent, hourly reconciliation and daily catch-up, protected auto-merge, owned supersession and the local caller pilot.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Plan: persist the verified candidate before requesting protected squash auto-merge, then exit. An hourly caller and daily catch-up inspect intent without installing dependencies; only a trusted merged candidate enters publication. Serialize all caller events, bind candidate/artifact/run/config identities, and refuse ambiguous registry or provenance results. Full live pilot and account-wide admission evidence remain outside this task authorization; PR will use Refs #249. Run targeted tests, lint and typecheck locally; CI owns the full gate.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implementation now has a dependency-free TypeScript probe, versioned candidate receipt in the bot PR, immutable run artifact retained for 90 days, exact source/digest/config checks and a publication-attempt journal. The hourly path skips installs when no intent exists. Sixteen new focused state/adapter tests pass, including late CI, suppressed bot push, hostile identity, crash recovery and authoritative supersession. Migrating legacy workflow-shape tests to the shared implementation and documenting the read-only fleet inventory.

value.text: Behavioral revert proofs ran in disposable copies only. Restoring the fixed implementation passed all 20 tests (11 decision + 9 adapter). Targeted package set passed 512 tests with zero failures/skips; lint, typecheck, build:test and docstrings passed; duplication is 0% across 125 sources. Focused release-continuation coverage is 100/100/100/100. Full npm/Bun release gates are delegated to PR CI as requested; no publication, merge, other-repository edit or hosted change was performed.
